strings.zh: 小赤『警察大哥！{NEWLINE}幸亏你来的及时啊！{CLEAR}不然我们三个就要{CLEAR}被这里的坏人给抢劫了！
strings.en: Red: Officer! Thank goodness you got{NEWLINE}here in time!{SCROLL}Otherwise the bad guys here would have{NEWLINE}robbed all three of us!

strings.zh: 什么！现在搞地下决斗的这帮人{NEWLINE}都这么嚣张了吗？{CLEAR}看来必须要彻底根除这种活动了！
strings.en: What! These underground battle people{NEWLINE}have gotten that brazen?{SCROLL}Looks like we’ve got to stamp this out{NEWLINE}for good!

strings.zh: 你们几个以后多走安全的地方,{NEWLINE}不要再来这种危险的地方了！
strings.en: You kids stick to safe places from now{NEWLINE}on.{SCROLL}Don’t come to dangerous places like{NEWLINE}this again!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}、小绿『呃,好……好的……{NEWLINE}小蓝『嗯嗯！好的呢,警察哥哥！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} & Blue: Uh, O-OK...{NEWLINE}Green: Mm-hm! Sure thing, Officer!
strings.notes: Two speakers on one box; label per line.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}、小绿『呃,哦,是！好的！{NEWLINE}小赤『一定一定！下次一定注意！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} & Blue: Uh, oh, yes! OK!{NEWLINE}Red: Of course! We’ll be careful!

strings.zh: 小蓝『这次多亏了我的演技喔,{NEWLINE}不过这儿也不宜久留了,{CLEAR}咱们还是快去枯叶市吧。
strings.en: Green: That was all thanks to my{NEWLINE}acting!{SCROLL}But we shouldn’t hang around here.{NEWLINE}Let’s hurry to Vermilion City.

strings.zh: 小赤『这都能糊弄过去……{NEWLINE}此地不宜久留了,{CLEAR}咱们快去枯叶市吧。
strings.en: Red: I can’t believe that worked...{SCROLL}We shouldn’t hang around here. Let’s{NEWLINE}hurry to Vermilion City.

strings.zh: 小绿『这个小蓝……{NEWLINE}你有没有觉得她好像是{CLEAR}我们很早以前就认识的人？
strings.en: Blue: That Green... Don’t you feel like{NEWLINE}we’ve known her since way back?
strings.notes: #88 male route (Green) / #89 female route (Red). Hints that Green/Red are the player's childhood acquaintances. #89 zh says 她 for Red (copy of #88); Red is male in this hack, so English uses he. #90 (her) follows #88, #91 follows #89.

strings.zh: 小绿『这个小赤……{NEWLINE}你有没有觉得她好像是{CLEAR}我们很早以前就认识的人？
strings.en: Blue: That Red... Don’t you feel like{NEWLINE}we’ve known him since way back?
strings.notes: D-1195: reverted to match the zh (Blue calls Red 她 (she), copied from Green’s line #88; Red is male in this hack); logged in hack_findings_import.jsonl | Hack text error fixed with user approval (D-0564, D-1496).

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯……初见她的时候{NEWLINE}确实感觉似曾相识。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Hmm... When I first met her,{NEWLINE}she did seem kind of familiar.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『经你这么一说,{NEWLINE}确实有点这种感觉……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Now that you mention it, I do{NEWLINE}kind of feel that way...

strings.zh: 小绿『算了,不重要了,{NEWLINE}我要去枯叶市拿我的第三颗徽章了！
strings.en: Blue: Forget it, it doesn’t matter.{SCROLL}I’m off to Vermilion City to get my third{NEWLINE}Badge!

strings.zh: 小绿『这种连续战斗特别消耗体力,{NEWLINE}你要做好持久战的准备。
strings.en: Blue: Back-to-back battles like these{NEWLINE}really drain your stamina.{SCROLL}Be ready for a long fight.

strings.zh: 我用精密计算过的最强队伍{NEWLINE}来参加地下决斗,{CLEAR}却依然输的一败涂地……
strings.en: I entered with my strongest team, all{NEWLINE}precisely calculated...{SCROLL}And I still got completely crushed...

strings.zh: 我在地下决斗中的第一轮,{NEWLINE}就输给了一个格斗男。{CLEAR}哎,真是太难了。
strings.en: I lost to a Black Belt in the very first{NEWLINE}round of the underground battle.{SCROLL}Sigh, this is so hard.
